rows.note: Bracket: $0 to $100,000. Order 2025-02 keeps the 2024-2025 rates for tax years beginning in 2026 (receipts did not exceed the $700M trigger).

sections.title: Iowa property tax: state rules

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: Counties, cities, school districts and special levying authorities (over 2,000 statewide)
rows.note: Assessors set values; the county auditor sets levy rates from local budgets; the county treasurer collects.

source.title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Iowa Tax/Fee Descriptions and Rates

rows.label: State oversight
rows.note: Supervises assessment, runs equalization every odd year and sets the annual assessment limitations.

source.title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Iowa Property Tax Overview

rows.label: Statewide limit on taxable value growth
rows.value: Annual assessment limitation (rollback) set by the Department of Revenue for residential, agricultural and other classes
rows.note: Taxable value = assessed value times the limitation percentage; the residential limitation for assessment year 2025 was 44.5345%.

source.title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Iowa Property Tax Overview

rows.label: Homestead exemption (from assessment year 2026)
rows.value: 10% of the homestead's taxable value, minimum $5,500 and maximum $20,000 of taxable value
rows.note: SF 2472 (2026) replaced the homestead credit (tax on $4,850 of value) with this exemption from assessment year 2026, i.e. taxes paid Sept 2027/March 2028. Age 65+ get a further $6,500.

source.title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Homestead Tax Credit and Exemption

sections.title: Iowa real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Real estate transfer tax rate
rows.value: $0.80 per $500 of the total price, with the first $500 exempt
rows.note: Each part-increment of $500 counts as a full increment. Paid to the county recorder when the deed is presented for recording.
